What is tTJS

　This is the class for the TJS2 script engine. You can operate TJS2 through objects of this class.

Constructor

　The constructor of tTJS takes no arguments.
tTJS objects cannot be created as automatic variables. They must always be created using the new operator.
The reference count immediately after creation is 1. This means that calling the Release method as is will release the tTJS object.

Destructor

tTJS's destructor is protected and cannot be accessed.
To release a tTJS object, use the Release method.
Also, it is recommended to call the Shutdown method before releasing a tTJS object.

AddRef

void tTJS::AddRef()

Increments the reference count of the TJS2 script engine.

Release

void tTJS::Release()

Decrements the reference count of the TJS2 script engine.
When the reference count reaches 0, the tTJS object is released.

Shutdown

void tTJS::Shutdown()

Performs the shutdown of the script engine.

When releasing the TJS2 script engine, it is recommended to call this method before calling the Release method.

GetGlobal

iTJSDispatch2 * tTJS::GetGlobal()

Gets the global object. An object of iTJSDispatch2 interface type is returned.
When this method returns the global object, it increments its reference count.

GetGlobalNoAddRef

iTJSDispatch2 * tTJS::GetGlobalNoAddRef()

Gets the global object. Unlike GetGlobal, it does not increment the reference count of the global object.

SetConsoleOutput

void tTJS::SetConsoleOutput(iTJSConsoleOutput *console);

Specifies the output destination of the console.
The console is where error messages and other output from TJS2 are output.

It takes the following arguments:

console
Specifies an object of type iTJSConsoleOutput, which defines the console output destination.
The iTJSConsoleOutput type is a base abstract class defined in tjs.h, with the following methods:

void iTJSConsoleOutput::ExceptionPrint(const tjs_char *msg)
　A method for outputting information about exceptions. msg represents the message.
void iTJSConsoleOutput::Print(const tjs_char *msg)
　A method for outputting other information. msg represents the message.

GetConsoleOutput

tTJSConsoleOutput * tTJS::GetConsoleOutput() const

Gets the console output destination.

OutputToConsole

void tTJS::OutputToConsole(const tjs_char *msg) const

Outputs a string to the console. msg is the message to output.

OutpuExceptionToConsole

void tTJS::OutpuExceptionToConsole(const tjs_char *msg) const

Outputs an exception string to the console. msg is the message to output.

OutputToConsoleWithCentering

void tTJS::OutputToConsoleWithCentering(const tjs_char *msg, tjs_uint width) const

Outputs a string centered to the console. msg is the message to output, and width is the width.
If the number of characters in the message to be output is smaller than the width, it outputs centered in the specified width (however, since all characters are treated as having equal width, mixing full-width characters will distort the display)

OutputToConsoleSeparator

void tTJS::OutputToConsoleSeparator(const tjs_char *text, tjs_uint count) const

Outputs the separator character specified by text count times to the console.

Dump

void tTJS::Dump(tjs_uint width = 80) const

Outputs the state of TJS2 to the console.
Displays results such as disassembly of virtual machine code in each script block.
Specify the width for output in width.

ExecScript

void tTJS::ExecScript(
    const tjs_char *script,
    tTJSVariant *result = NULL,
    iTJSDispatch2 *context = NULL,
    const tjs_char *name = NULL,
    tjs_int lineofs = 0
    )

void tTJS::ExecScript(
    const ttstr &script,
    tTJSVariant *result = NULL,
    iTJSDispatch2 *context = NULL,
    const tjs_char *name = NULL,
    tjs_int lineofs = 0
    )

Executes a script.

It takes the following arguments:

const tjs_char *script
const ttstr &script
　Specifies the script to execute.
tTJSVariant *result
　Specifies a pointer to a tTJSVariant type variable to receive the result.
NULL can also be specified, but if NULL is specified, the result cannot be received.
iTJSDispatch2 *context
　Specifies the context in which this script is executed.
If NULL is specified, the script is executed in the global context.
Normally NULL is specified, but if you want to execute the script in a specific context, specify the object that serves as that context.
const tjs_char *name
　Specifies the name of the script. Usually, specify the file name of that script.
It is used for notifying which script an exception occurred in when an exception is reported.
tjs_int lineofs
　Specifies the line in the script where that script starts (0-based).
When a TJS script is embedded inside another document, such as a TJS script embedded in a KAG scenario, specify the starting line of that TJS script.
It is used for notifying which script an exception occurred in when an exception is reported.

EvalExpression

void tTJS::EvalExpression(
    const tjs_char *expression,
    tTJSVariant *result = NULL,
    iTJSDispatch2 *context = NULL,
    const tjs_char *name = NULL
    tjs_int lineofs = 0
    )

void tTJS::EvalExpression(
    const ttstr &expression,
    tTJSVariant *result = NULL,
    iTJSDispatch2 *context = NULL,
    const tjs_char *name = NULL
    tjs_int lineofs = 0
    )

Evaluates an expression.
Refer to ExecScript for arguments.

For operators whose result cannot be obtained, such as the if operator, specifying a non-NULL value for result in an attempt to get the result will raise an exception. In this case, NULL must be specified for result.

SetPPValue

void tTJS::SetPPValue(const tjs_char *name, const tjs_int32 value)

Sets a variable for conditional compilation. name is the name of the variable, and value is the value to set.

GetPPValue

tjs_int32 tTJS::GetPPValue(const tjs_char *name)

Gets a variable for conditional compilation. name is the name of the variable. If the variable is not found, 0 is returned.

DoGarbageCollection

tjs_int32 tTJS::DoGarbageCollection()

Performs garbage collection. Clears caches held by TJS2 and completes pending cleanup operations.
